messages.english: Export saved field layouts for Google Earth.
messages.translation: Rhumerisa maakanyelo ya masimu lama hlayisiweke eka Google Earth.
Design Studio → Ku byala → Swiyenge swa masimu

messages.english: Choose one field or all fields, then download the saved boundaries, beds and path lines as KML. Labels are optional; map-reference locations are not surveyed boundaries.
messages.translation: Hlawula nsimu yin'we kumbe masimu hinkwawo, kutani u kopa mindzilekano leyi hlayisiweke, timbhedwa to byala (beds) na milayeni ya tindlela tanihi KML. Maswayi a swi bohi; tindhawu ta le mepeni a hi mindzilekano leyi pimiweke hi nkambisiso wa misava (survey).
